funny-mad-racing.title: Funny Mad Racing: Free Online Wacky Racing Game
funny-mad-racing.slogan: Master Wacky Tracks and Defy Gravity!
funny-mad-racing.description: Get ready for a bouncing and bumping ride in Funny Mad Racing! This quirky driving game offers unique physics-based gameplay where you control your vehicle's balance to navigate challenging tracks. Choose between single-player or two-player modes, and race to the finish line. With breathtaking tracks and off-road car maneuvers, Funny Mad Racing promises endless fun and excitement. Play now and experience the thrill!
